statement: The pinned WiiBrew Extension Controllers Identification list distinguishes Wii-port accessory six-byte unencrypted IDs: Guitar Hero guitar 00 00 A4 20 01 03; Guitar Hero World Tour drums 01 00 A4 20 01 03; DJ Hero turntable 03 00 A4 20 01 03; TaTaCon drum 00 00 A4 20 01 11; uDraw tablet FF 00 A4 20 01 12; Drawsome tablet FF 00 A4 20 00 13; Densha de GO! Shinkansen controller 00 00 A4 20 03 10; Wii Balance Board 00 00 A4 20 04 02. The leading bytes distinguish devices even when the trailing type bytes coincide. The listed Balance Board identity is part of a standalone controller, not a plug-in accessory. These documented identities are out of C5 scope; its acceptance manifest enumerates Nunchuk, Classic, Classic Pro and MotionPlus rather than these accessories.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documentation, no model-specific retail hardware capture
applicability.scope: WiiBrew pinned oldids: Extension Controllers oldid 121955, Identification and List of extension controllers. Related: wii-kernel-extension-init (classifies guitar/drums/turntable/Balance Board differently), wii-c5-extension-identifiers and Wii C5 acceptance/virtualgamepad.wii-remote.toml. No raw data or copied identification table; community data, no physical SKU validation. Community-source evidence only, not device measurement.
